'''Thulpin City''' was the agricultural center of the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Draenell's Point]]. It was located on the grasslands of the [[Mee'r]] continent and was home to [[Thulpin Agriculture]]. It was home to one million inhabitants.<ref name="GK" /> [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] stored in the city's [[agricultural loading platform XT-21s]] was the target of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Battle of Bissillirus|operation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="S" />
